agent_summary:
Lane 75 (Configuration) tested against juice.lab.test, an OWASP Juice Shop (app version 20.2.0, Express ^4.22.1) behind nginx/1.30.5, HTTP only (443 refused). 120 read-only exchanges performed.

Items done (evidence attached):
- CONF-01 (network infra): nginx/1.30.5 reverse-proxying Node/Express; wildcard CORS on all responses.
- CONF-02 (platform config): /rest/admin/application-version (20.2.0) and /rest/admin/application-configuration (full config incl. Google OAuth clientId) served unauthenticated; /metrics (Prometheus) public; verbose Express error pages with stack traces/server paths on 4xx/5xx; no CSP/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy/HSTS.
- CONF-03 (file extensions): /ftp enforces .md/.pdf (403) but poison-null-byte (%2500.md) bypasses it to download .bak/.yml/.kdbx/.pyc source — confirmed on package.json.bak, coupons, suspicious_errors.yml, incident-support.kdbx, encrypt.pyc.
- CONF-04 (backup/unreferenced): /ftp directory listing (via robots Disallow) exposes leftover files; contents retrieved. /.git and webroot source/config files are NOT exposed (catch-all index.html).
- CONF-05 (admin interfaces): no server-side admin console (/console,/administration fall to SPA catch-all; real admin is JWT-gated client route /#/administration); exposed infra interfaces are /support/logs and /ftp(/quarantine) listings, /metrics, and unauthenticated /rest/admin/application-* endpoints.
- CONF-06 (HTTP methods): OPTIONS advertises GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE with ACAO:*; CORS returns a static '*' (origin not reflected, no credentials). Write methods not exercised (read-only engagement).
- CONF-07 (HSTS): host is HTTP-only and no Strict-Transport-Security header — not enforced.
- CONF-08 (RIA cross-domain): no crossdomain.xml/clientaccesspolicy.xml (both return catch-all).

Items N/A:
- CONF-09 (file permissions): OS-level permissions not assessable over read-only HTTP (related world-readable exposure captured in CONF-04/05).
- CONF-10 (subdomain takeover): single in-scope host served directly by nginx, no CNAME/dangling target.
- CONF-11 (cloud storage): no S3/GCS/Azure references; assets/config served locally from /assets.

Leads recorded: null-byte extension bypass (high), /support/logs log directory listing (medium), multiple serve-index listings (medium), verbose error/stack traces (low), unauthenticated /metrics & application-configuration (low). Note for other lanes: /rest/memories, /api/Feedbacks, /rest/products/*/reviews and /rest/user/security-question expose user emails/data without auth; open redirect at /redirect is whitelisted (blocked, 406 on arbitrary target). No writes proposed.

leads.title: [agent] File-extension filter bypass via poison null byte on /ftp

detail.text: /ftp restricts downloads to .md/.pdf (403 otherwise), but appending %2500.md bypasses it: GET /ftp/package.json.bak%2500.md (200, full source), /ftp/coupons_2013.md.bak%2500.md (200), /ftp/suspicious_errors.yml%2500.md (200, text/yaml). Allows retrieval of backup/config files, including incident-support.kdbx.

Directory listings are enabled and reachable unauthenticated at /ftp, /ftp/quarantine, /support/logs (and the expected /.well-known, /.well-known/csaf). /support/logs exposes server logs and /ftp exposes backup/config files, broadening the attack surface and aiding other lanes.

leads.title: [agent] Server log directory listing exposed at /support/logs

detail.text: GET http://juice.lab.test/support/logs returns HTTP 200 with a serve-index HTML directory listing (8.9KB) without authentication, exposing server log files for download. Sensitive information disclosure.

GET /metrics returns 26KB of Prometheus metrics without auth; GET /rest/admin/application-configuration returns full app config (Google OAuth clientId, internal flags) unauthenticated. Verbose Express error pages also leak framework version and server file paths/stack traces.

leads.title: [agent] Verbose error pages / stack traces on 4xx-5xx responses

detail.text: Several endpoints return detailed Express error pages exposing framework version and server-side file paths/stack traces: /ftp (403), /rest/chatbot/status (500, ~2.4KB), /rest/order-history unauthenticated (500), /profile (500), /dataerasure (500). Error handling is in debug/verbose mode, leaking internal paths like /juice-shop/build/routes/*.js.

items.na_reason: [agent] OS-level file permissions cannot be assessed over read-only HTTP; related exposure of world-readable files is captured under CONF-04 (/ftp) and CONF-05 (/support/logs).

[agent] Only the single in-scope host juice.lab.test is present (resolves to an internal address, served directly by nginx); no CNAME to a third-party/dangling service and no additional subdomains in scope, so there is no subdomain-takeover condition to test.

[agent] No cloud storage in use: application-configuration and product/asset data are served locally from /assets; no S3/GCS/Azure bucket references found in config or client scripts, so there is no cloud bucket to test.
